note: Ready-made public cohorts. You do not need to upload anything to run one: every LEI here is public and already in the published screen. Each cohort states its own universe and carries the same limits as the screen itself.
boundaries: Screening signal only; not evidence of misconduct, discrimination, causation or legal violation.
No individual application is described or predicted.
Cohort membership is a research choice, not a judgement about any institution.

top-volume-fha.title: Twenty largest FHA lenders by modelled volume, 2025
top-volume-fha.question: Which of the biggest FHA lenders sit above or below the denial rate their own applicant mix predicts?
top-volume-fha.universe: FHA forward loans, 2025; lenders ranked by applications inside the expectation model

high-coverage-only.title: Lenders whose profile coverage exceeds 90%
high-coverage-only.question: If we keep only the lenders the model can see clearly, does the picture change?
high-coverage-only.universe: FHA forward loans, 2025; profile_coverage_pct >= 90 only — the cohort that exists to test whether coverage drives the result

above-expectation.title: Every lender whose 95% interval lies entirely above 1.0
above-expectation.question: Which lenders deny more than their own mix predicts, with the interval excluding parity?
above-expectation.universe: FHA forward loans, 2025; flag=above_expectation_ci_excludes_1 and coverage >= 70

depository-institutions.title: FHA lenders that are also FDIC-insured depositories
depository-institutions.question: Do banks behave differently from independent mortgage banks on the same program?
depository-institutions.universe: FHA forward loans, 2025, intersected with the FDIC BankFind institution list via fuzzy name match (join_type=fuzzy_name, confidence >= 0.80)

screening-only.title: The cohort the model cannot see well
screening-only.question: What does a list look like when coverage is too thin to claim a signal?
screening-only.universe: FHA forward loans, 2025; rows flagged screening_only_insufficient_coverage — published so the limits of the screen are as visible as its findings
